causes.label: Dryer is unplugged
remedies: Make sure the dryer plug is pushed completely into the outlet.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 13: "Dryer is unplugged"

causes.label: Fuse is blown/circuit breaker is tripped
remedies: Check the house fuse/circuit breaker box and replace fuse or reset breaker.
NOTE: Most electric dryers use two fuses/breakers.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 13: "Fuse is blown/circuit breaker is tripped"

causes.label: Fuse is blown/circuit breaker is tripped, the dryer may tumble but not heat
remedies: Check the house fuse/circuit breaker box and replace fuse or reset breaker.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 13: "Fuse is blown/circuit breaker is tripped, the dryer may tumble but not heat"

causes.label: Gas service is off
remedies: Make sure gas shutoff at dryer and main shutoff are fully open.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 13: "Gas service is off"

causes.label: Some shaking/noise is normal. Dryer may be sitting unevenly
remedies: Move dryer to an even floor space, or adjust leveling legs as necessary until even.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 13: "Some shaking/noise is normal. Dryer may be sitting unevenly"

causes.label: Improper use of fabric softener
remedies: Follow directions on fabric softener package.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 13: "Improper use of fabric softener"

causes.label: Lint filter is full
remedies: Clean lint screen before each load.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 13: "Lint filter is full"

causes.label: Improper sorting
remedies: Sort lint producers (like chenille) from lint collectors (like corduroy).
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 13: "Improper sorting"

causes.label: Static electricity can attract lint
remedies: See suggestions in this section under STATIC.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 13: "Static electricity can attract lint"

causes.label: Overloading
remedies: Separate large loads into smaller ones.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 13: "Overloading"

causes.label: Paper, tissue, etc., left in pockets
remedies: Empty all pockets before laundering clothes.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 13: "Paper, tissue, etc., left in pockets"

causes.label: No fabric softener was used
remedies: Try a fabric softener.
Bounce® Fabric Conditioner Dryer Sheets have been approved for use in all GE Dryers when used in accordance with the manufacturer’s instructions.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 13: "No fabric softener was used"

causes.label: Overdrying
remedies: Try a fabric softener.
Adjust controls for less drying.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 13: "Overdrying"

causes.label: Type of heat
remedies: Automatic drying times will vary according to the type of heat used (electric, natural or LP gas), size of load, types of fabrics, wetness of clothes and condition of exhaust ducts.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 13: "Type of heat"

symptoms.symptom: Clothes take too long to dry

causes.label: Improper sorting
remedies: Separate heavy items from lightweight items (generally, a well-sorted washer load is a well-sorted dryer load).
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 14: "Improper sorting"

causes.label: Large loads of heavy fabrics (like beach towels)
remedies: Large, heavy fabrics contain more moisture and take longer to dry.
Separate large, heavy fabrics into smaller loads to speed drying time.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 14: "Large loads of heavy fabrics (like beach towels)"

causes.label: Controls improperly set
remedies: Match control settings to the load you are drying.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 14: "Controls improperly set"

causes.label: Lint filter is full
remedies: Clean lint filter before every load.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 14: "Lint filter is full"

causes.label: Improper or obstructed ducting
remedies: Check installation instructions for proper ducting/venting.
Make sure ducting is clean, free of kinks and unobstructed.
Check to see if outside wall damper operates easily.
Check the Installation Instructions to make sure the dryer venting is correct.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 14: "Improper or obstructed ducting"

causes.label: Blown fuses or tripped circuit breaker
remedies: Replace fuses or reset circuit breakers.
Since most dryers use 2 fuses/breakers, make sure both are operating.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 14: "Blown fuses or tripped circuit breaker"

causes.label: Overloading/combining loads
remedies: Do not put more than one washer load in the dryer at a time.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 14: "Overloading/combining loads"

causes.label: Underloading
remedies: If you are drying only one or two items, add a few items to ensure proper tumbling.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 14: "Underloading"

causes.label: Overdrying
remedies: Select a shorter drying time.
Remove items while they still hold a slight amount of moisture.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 14: "Overdrying"

causes.label: Letting items sit in dryer after cycle ends
remedies: Remove items when cycle ends and fold or hang immediately.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 14: "Letting items sit in dryer after cycle ends"
